text: {"lessons":["I repeatedly sold stocks at a gain, but those wins did not prevent my account value from falling; I should judge decisions by total portfolio performance, not realized gains alone.","A stock being above my average cost is not, by itself, a reason to sell; I should compare its future prospects with my alternatives and avoid cutting winners automatically.","I should set position-size and rebalancing rules in advance, balancing risk and diversification rather than letting the satisfaction of locking in gains drive my trades."]}
